nom: Bloomeffects Royal Tulip Hydrating Bi-Phase Tonic

avis.texte: Love this and haru haru wonder. The best milky toners of the lot!
Very hydrating!!!! I use this product day and night as a toner and extra hydration/moisturizer.

I was really excited to try because of all the great reviews but unfortunately I didn't find this to be hydrating or moisturizing at all. It also slightly irritates my skin once applied. It just didn't work for my skin.
So hydrating and my skin drinks this up! I love the way it makes my skin look and feel!

I didnt expect to fall in love with this toner but I did. Its so hydrating and leaves my face so glowy which I love, but I also noticed the more I used it the more my redness went away and it really helped my skin barrier get better as well as improved the texture of my skin. Not only that, but it literally makes my face so soft! I will be repurchasing as an UB associate!
I tries this because I kept seeing reviews. Immediately this was a yes. It is so very hydrating and layers well with my other products. I'll be making sure inalways have a back up!

I am obsessed with this toner! Its hydrating like a milky toner but is not too heavy, not heavy at all actually. Makes your skin silky smooth and gives you a great glow!! Layers well with all of my other skincare as well. And its fun to shake the bottle to mix it up! Glass bottle also makes it feel very luxe.

Gentle enough for my sensitive skin glowing, all while delivering a powerful dose of hydration. Not only is it satisfying to emulsify the product each morning, but the is easy to dispense and use. I will be rebuying this in the future!

This toner is the real deal. It's not just like spritzing rose water on your face. If you have sensitive or dry skin or just picky/red/irritated skin due to whatever, this could be your best friend. I put it in my palm and pat it on my face. I let it mostly dry before moisturizer. I think it really helps reduce redness and balances and gives light moisture. Kind of silently magical!

I love this toner! Everything about it! Makes my skin feel nourished, moisturized and smooth. I'm on my second bottle already. Truly a great product and a staple in my skincare routine! And a little goes a long way.
Very nourishing light toner that helps keep me moisturized through the night.

I have been wanting to try bloomeffects for awhile and then finally got my hands on the serum while it was on sale at ulta and instantly fell in love with it so i had to get the tulip tonic and omg i just love love love both of them!! Bloomeffects you are loved here!!!!!!
I have very reactive skin and huge pores. I feel like this moisturizes and has helped reduce redness. I also think it helps my pores look smaller.

avis.titre: This is the best milky toner i have ever tried
avis.texte: So I bought this after watching Alex, Sarah ans Zobia the cosmetic chemists. This product is genuinely outstanding. The texture, the smell, the colour and the way eveything is packaged makes this perfect. I cannot fault this. I have already reviewed it on TikTok - I have a small base but this is honestly 10/10

This tonic is a total skin-refresher! It gives me that perfect lit-from-within luminosity without feeling heavy. My face feels incredibly soft and balanced after every use—I'm genuinely excited to apply this every morning.
This phase tonic makes my skin glow! I have only been using it for week or so but I am addicted. This has become a must have in my routine. My skin feels soft and looks so healthy and radiant.
Love this tonic. This is my second bottle and will be an everyday staple in my skincare. Very hydrating and sits well under makeup
Love how smooth and supple my face feels after using! Can't wait to try more products from you guys!!!
After using this for a few days I will be sure this is always in my rotation going forward. It is so hydrating and refershing.
Oh my stars, this is such a great milky type toner and it's so hydrating! The only thing I wish it had was a spray top; otherwise, it's stellar.

I recently bought the royal tulip hydrating biphase tonic and I love it. It is not too thick, but somehow still feels very silky and hydrating. I love that it doesn't feel heavy or sticky when used with other products.
I usually tend to breakout with "milky toners" but si far for mt sensitive skin this feels okay
This is a very nourishing yet lightweight milky toner. Smell is very mild. Great for sensitive skin.

This is such a beautiful creamy, rich, soothing and luxurious toner that makes you feel as if you used a moisturizer. I bought 2 backup during the black Friday sale, I refuse to live without this product it is that good

My dry mature skin loves this tonic. I am extremely sensitive and fight redness from rosacea but using this tonic, especially with the royal jelly, my skin looks healthy and hydrated and ten years younger.

I have very problematic skin with acne scars, uneven tone, and dull skin. I tried this bi toner for one night and woke up with VISIBLY less pigmentation on my cheeks from acne and glowing hydrated skin. I highly recommend for everyday use:)
Love how lightweight this toner is. So hydrating and feels really nide on the skin
The bi-phase tonic is moisturizing and soothing. Sometimes, in the evening this tonic is the last layer for my sensitive skin. Very nice product!
It's only been a week but so far I love it. I use it in my day and night routine. I will continue to use everyday
I've only been using Royal Tulip Hydrating Bi-Phase Tonic for about two weeks and I'm obsessed! I love how it makes my skin feel. I'm also acne prone and so far no breakouts.

I just love love the Bloom Effects Bi Phase Toner ! I started my skincare journey in September after radiation. Omg what a difference this Bi Phase toner has done for me. I use it morning and night and my skin color is more even toned, my crows feet have reduced dramatically! My skin feels so Moisturized living in Colorado! OBVIOUSLY will buy again
I love this toner is very hydrating and calm my skin very well. My skin type very dry/sensitive.

This tonic is pure glow in a bottle. The bi-phase formula feels incredibly refreshing and leaves my skin hydrated, calm, and bouncy without any residue. It instantly preps my skin and makes everything I apply after absorb better. My complexion looks healthier and more radiant every time I use it.

avis.titre: Hydrating, gentle, and easy to use
avis.texte: This is a really nice everyday toner. I like the bi-phase formula and how it feels once shaken and applied — hydrating, calming, and not heavy at all. My skin feels comfortable right away, not tight or sticky. It's gentle, layers well, and doesn't irritate my dry, sensitive skin. However If you use too much, it can feel a little rich, especially if you're layering several products. Also the price is on the higher side for a toner. that's more about hydration and comfort than visible results.

After subscribing to Tata Harper and Chantecaille for years, I can honestly say this product is better than their toners for a fraction of the cost. I'm so impressed with the results. I see a visible difference—my skin is more radiant and plump, even after a full day of commuting and working. This product competes with the best of the best.

I never want to be without this. Always have 1 open and 1 backup. The best toner I have ever used. This is up there with Tulip Nectar and Regenerative Serum as Bloomeffects products that are simply undupable and products that actually give noticeable results.

avis.titre: Royal tulip hydrating bi phase tonic
avis.texte: I really enjoy this tonic. It does add hydration and moisture and is a good base for the hydration nectar
Best toner of the year. Just ordered my 3rd bottle and will use this until the a day I die. So soothing and hydrating-my skin tone has evened out… it just is a pleasure to use

this formula feels gorgeous, lightweight and balanced and makes my skin look significantly brighter and softer after implementing this into my routine. this better not be limited edition-- i love this and think this is a new staple for me!
Love the texture and doesn't have any strong odor. Gentle on my combination to sensitive skin. Leaves skin hydrated as desired.
Love this toner! Leaves my face feeling hydrated and soft thus will be a staple in n routine

I'm so happy that I invested in this product. The air has been really dry lately and it's been a brutal winter. My hands and face have been suffering. Whenever I put this on at night it's immediate relief. I'm genuinely thrilled with the results I'm seeing after only about a week of use and I can't wait to try more Bloom Effects products!

I find this toner hydrating and calming without being sticky. I find the sensorial experience truly luxurious - nice bottle, fun to shake the bottle to combine the ingredients, feels lovely on the skin, beautiful blue color. I have not been using long enough to notice long-term effects, but in the short term it is definitely providing the hydration that I need. I have oily skin that needs a drink of water that won't weigh it down.
Love this product. I instantly so positive results. My skin feels more hydrated and firm.
My skin instantly improved and glowed after one use, no exaggeration. Amazing product and smells so good!
I am really loving this milky toner. It is very nourishing and elegant. I use it with my retinal and it soothes my skin. Bonus...It's has a beautiful bi-phase blue hue. Highly recommend!

I am shocked at how much I love this toner. I skin flood so have many toners in my rotation. This one was an instant HG for me and I stocked up immediately! So thankful it has made it into the permanent line. My skin feels nourished & moisturized with a dewy finish, but not heavy at all. Like a deep hydrating hug for your face. Packaging and color is gorgeous as well. They really knocked it out of the park with this one!

I've been using the Royal Tulip Hydrating Bi-Phase Tonic consistently, and I genuinely love the way this toner feels on my skin. The texture is lightweight but nourishing, and every time I apply it, my skin gets this instant plump, dewy boost that makes my routine feel luxurious. What I've noticed most is how beautifully it has helped even out my appearance. My skin looks smoother, more balanced, and just healthier. It gives me that fresh, well-rested glow even on days when I'm running on principal energy only. It layers perfectly with the rest of my products, never pills, and always leaves my skin looking soft, hydrated, and radiant. If you're looking for a toner that delivers moisture and glow without feeling heavy, this one is a total win. A tulip-powered tonic that truly lives up to the hype. 🌷
It is a little early to claim any results, but I can report no irritation and it leaves a nice finish on my face for adding more treatments!

I have tried so many toners and usually layer different toners in my routine , but I have simplified with this toner. It gives me everything I need while leaving a beautiful glow. I'm beyond thrilled to hear it's a permanent offering. I can't imagine my routine without this now!

I was a bit weary of giving into the hype and because this is a skinfluencer collab but I am glad I tried it. Not only do I love the formula but just the product sitting on your vanity is so cool and aesthetically pleasing. I have hypersensitive skin and this does not break me out or irritate my skin. I actually got a bottle during the BF sale and was tempted to get more!!

To say OBSESSED would be an understatement! This is exactly what my skin needed as we shift into the colder months. This feels so gentle and hydrating. It can be layered without added heaviness. Plus it's fun to shake up, like you're mixing your own potion!
I'm 64 years young! Feels like a Serum and Moisturizer All in One Product! Definitely will purchase it again!
My skin is oily to normal and I absolutely love how this makes my face feel! It hydrating and my skin has a glow. It absorbes well. No irritation. I use it in my AM and PM skin routine!

avis.titre: Please keep this as a permanent product!
avis.texte: I love this so much I ordered enough for the next 6 months in case it goes away. It is hydrating, non irritating, and actually very soothing. You don't need much so a bottle should last awhile. Price point is also great. Please keep this special edition in the lineup long term!

I try a lot of beauty/skincare products, and this one is outstanding. Truly so impressed with it. Perfect amount of moisture (often don't even need moisturizer over top). It is soothing and reduces redness. Sits beautifully under sunscreen and makeup. Fun to apply and use. Overall just a beautiful product
Hydration and glow! I use an additional moisturizer now that it's colder and the air is dry, but in the summer this will be perfect on its own without the need for additional lotion. I LOVE it!

Exactly as advertised! Calming, moisturizing, plumping and has the best feel! Easily my favorite product to apply. Pro tip: use some on any rough spots on your body - like your armpits! They will thank you.

This is my most favorite face product that I've gotten in a long time. It really smooths out my skin and helps it retain moisture. I'm excited to gift it to the ladies in my family for the holidays. Can't wait to share!
I'm love the way this makes my skin look and feel. You could probably skip the moisturizer if you use this. Just the right amount of shine and moisture, without feeling gooey.
Product is very hydrating. Packaging is very pretty on the shelf. The color is gorgeous.
Saw this on Instagram and decided to try it. So far I love they at it makes my face feel. And a little goes a line way!!!

I've never tried anything from this brand but love Sarah and her content so I had to buy and support her. WOW I'm combo, acne prone, sensitive skin and this toner really is a serum, toner, and if you're not dry a moisturizer (during the day!)

In addition to being beautiful and innovative, this pack, a powerful hydration punch! Be careful with how much you use. I ended up using too much one time and could feel it. It's great to beef up my hydration going into winter.
Love this. So hydrating. Leaving my face feeling plump and smooth.

This is the best toner I have ever used! My skin feel hydrated, moisturized and smooth. This makes my skin feel velvety to the touch and look so much more luminous but not greasy or oily. Definitely need a back up for my back up!

This is heavenly! I bought 2 so I have a backup, and will probably buy a 3rd today for the Anniversary sale. This is great for my combo skin. It doesn't leave it greasy feeling, in 2 weeks time I have seen improvements in skin tone, breakouts, and redness. I also have noticed my skin is not getting as irritated from acids and my Tretinoin-tho I am not sure if that is from the Toner. I'm just praying Bloomeffects keeps this once the Sarah Palmeri Limited Edition ones are gone. It's my second fav Bloomeffects product.
Seriously obsessed with this product! It's very lightweight, not thick, and super hydrating and calming. My skin loves layers and layers of it!

I bought this because of the post from sarah palmyra and i really love her stuff. I'm so glad I purchased it, it's like a pillow for your face. It's beautiful, creamy, and it works so nicely so far. I will be absolutely purchasing it again and again, that's for sure. It's not heavily scented at all. I truly love it.
This stuff is creamy magic in a bottle. My face feels rejuvenated and oh so hydrated after using. And the glow?! Love it.

avis.titre: One of the best toners I have used
avis.texte: This is one of, if not the best toner I have used. It's similar to the Rhode in that it has this quick drying feeling that I love. It's way more hydrating and better for oily skin though. I use it morning and night… and really have seen my skin just look more even and just… better. I hope Bloomeffects keeps selling this after the limited version is gone. It's really a phenomenal product.
Absolutely love the Bi-Phase Tonic. It is just as described , hydrating. Feels so good on my skin and allows me to get rid of several toners and essences since it does it all!
I don't think I could live without this lovely potion. So much more than a toner, it's a serum and has actives. My mature skin glows after using. Standing ovation
I'm really enjoying the hydration this tonic has added to my routine. The real test will be this winter when the air is dry. But based on the results thus far, I expect great results!
